summary: Bluerock Private Real Estate Fund filed an 8-K to disclose entry into an Administrative Services Agreement with its adviser, Bluerock Fund Advisor, LLC. The agreement sets a 0.20% annual fee on average managed assets for services such as joint venture administration and NYSE compliance. The adviser voluntarily waives the fee on assets still invested in institutional funds, cutting the effective waiver to about 53% currently. The agreement is terminable on 60 days' notice. This is a routine operational contract, not a special situation event, so no deal terms apply.
